thought.text: Service dibuat dan masuk antrean. Sekarang tunggu build selesai, lalu tes endpoint-nya.

action.command: cd /workspace/project/apps/inktest && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"; export INK_API_KEY='dk_live_b6fa078ef6101c5c0cb43debb5152a8e619d72e45c907dcfa977bf2f7e001677'; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 20; S=$(ink status inktest1 --json 2>/dev/null); echo "[$i] $(echo "$S" | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('status'),d.get('endpoint',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "$S" | head -c 120)"; echo "$S" | grep -q '"status": *"running"' && break; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project/apps/inktest && export PATH=\"$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH\"; export INK_API_KEY='dk_live_b6fa078ef6101c5c0cb43debb5152a8e619d72e45c907dcfa977bf2f7e001677'; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 20; S=$(ink status inktest1 --json 2>/dev/null); echo \"[$i] $(echo \"$S\" | python3 -c \"import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('status'),d.get('endpoint',''))\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"$S\" | head -c 120)\"; echo \"$S\" | grep -q '\"status\": *\"running\"' && break; done", "summary": "Poll deployment status until running", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 300}
